comment: Toy 8-dimension vectors for the atlas-core fixture corpus (fixture_corpus.sql). The Python fixture generator monkeypatches embed_query to return qvec_raw normalized exactly as embed_query does; the Rust tests inject the same qvec_raw through a fixed embedder. Chunk 5's vector equals qvec_raw (cosine 1.0 after normalization): it is the ceiling canary. Document vectors are stored unnormalized; both implementations normalize rows at load, as production does.
